requirements: Enumerate window.midnight entries only on explicit discovery action; render names/identifiers/API versions as text, never HTML. Do not fetch untrusted icon URLs automatically.
Explicit selection; never select the first injected wallet by default.
Connect initiated synchronously by user click; sign initiated only by a second consent click.
getConnectionStatus().networkId and getConfiguration().networkId must both be exactly preprod; recheck before and after signing.
Feature-detect connect, getConnectionStatus, getConfiguration, getUnshieldedAddress and signData; method presence alone never qualifies.
Require exact approved framing/encoding profile for wallet implementation and version, canonical returned bytes, signature verification, verifying-key-derived payload equality and expiry checks.
Respect wallet service configuration; this probe requires no indexer, prover, wallet balance or transaction service call.
Any failure is a fixed redacted category. Keep payloads in memory only; no storage, URLs, analytics, telemetry, console or evidence.
Unsupported wallets retain simulation access only. No signing result establishes a submitted receipt or verified participant.
